logic.entry: Aggregate UTC daily high,low andlast close over1440closed minutes. IBS=(C-L)/(H-L);ifH=L,set0.5. One completed bar,no smoothing or prior-close gap term. Exact Fraction from dailyFloat64decimal strings,no threshold rounding;Decimal60display,canonical ratioSHA. AccountingDecimal28 unchanged. While flat,enter iff IBS<entry_ibs_threshold,strict,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long,exit iff IBS>exit_ibs_threshold,strict;equality keeps long. No trend filter,RSI,short,hold cap,future padding,fold reset or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.
